dashboard.title: Operations dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Today's snapshot of arrivals, departures and house status.
dashboard.empty_body: Connect a property in Settings to start receiving reservations.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your work email and password.
login.generic_error: The email or password is incorrect, or the account is locked.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you use to sign in. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.generic_success: If an account exists for that email, we just sent a password-reset link. Check your inbox.

reset.success: Your password has been reset. You can sign in now.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.generic_error: We couldn't reset your password. The link may have expired; request a new one.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.subtitle: Open the email we sent you and click the verification link. You can resend it below.

two_factor.challenge_subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
two_factor.generic_error: That code is not correct. Try again.
two_factor.setup_required: Your account requires two-factor authentication. Please set it up to continue.
two_factor.disabled: Two-factor authentication has been turned off.
two_factor.setup_subtitle: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code below to confirm.
two_factor.scan_label: Or paste this URI into your authenticator
two_factor.codes_subtitle: Save these codes somewhere safe. Each one can be used once if you lose your authenticator.
two_factor.regenerate_confirm: Are you sure? The old codes stop working immediately.
two_factor.disable_confirm: Are you sure? This will sign you out of other devices.

email.verify_body: Click the button below to verify your email and finish setting up your account.
email.resent: Verification email sent. Check your inbox.
email.reset_body: You (or someone using your email) asked to reset your Stayflow password. Click the button below to choose a new one.
email.reset_expiry: This link expires in 60 minutes. If you did not ask for a reset, ignore this email.
email.recovery_code_used_subject: A recovery code was used to sign in to your account
email.recovery_code_used_body: One of your two-factor recovery codes was just used to sign in. You have :count codes left.
email.recovery_code_used_action: If this was not you, change your password immediately and review the devices signed in to your account.
